_meta.note: Gemstone mutation RECIPES (G6 owner ruling 2026-07-23 round 3, char-sheet repo rulebook/skills-passover.md; book gpt-system-v0.92.md §4.5). A mutation merges compatible parent skills at the Skill Gemstone into a new skill: parents must be owned at >= min_level and pairwise share a NARROW keyword per the G3 rule (data/skill_keywords.json), BOTH parents are CONSUMED, and the result arrives at the recipe level. simulation/skill_forge.gd is the engine (validate_mutation / apply_mutation — pure, all-violations-at-once). COST: the compendium's Modification Center prices a Skill Gemstone use at 1 Bronze ('disassemble/consume/merge') — that is ECONOMY, deliberately unpriced in this engine; KAN-7 progression owns pricing. Recipes validate against skill KEYS + LEVELS only — SkillBook implementation is NOT required (CombatantState.from_spec accepts any {key, level} grant row), so a roster can own the result as data before its content pass.
_meta.schema: mutation: { key (unique recipe id), name (display), parents: [{key, min_level}] (>= 2 distinct skill keys), result: {key, level} (not a parent key), note (provenance + economy), compatibility_override? (bool — authored GM override for a recipe whose parents do NOT share a narrow keyword; the G3 broad-only GM-call tier made explicit. No shipped recipe needs it: Intercept x Brace share the narrow keyword 'bracing') }

mutations.name: Iron Stance
mutations.note: THE first authored Gemstone mutation and the book §4.5 canonical example (G6 round 3, owner 2026-07-23): Intercept Lv 5 + Brace Lv 3 — compatible through 'bracing' — merge into Iron Stance; the mobile bodyguard consumes the self-brace and becomes the rooted bulwark. Both parents consumed; the mutation arrives at level 1. Effect (table canon, seeded template): stance — while you hold your ground, attacks on adjacent allies retarget to you, plus persistent Crush/Burn reduction. IMPLEMENTED (content pass batch B): the retarget-guard archetype landed in ActionResolver — Intercept and Iron Stance are both in SkillBook.KNOWN_KEYS, so this recipe's result is a real, usable stance (the R27 DATA-ONLY interim is retired).
